'''Fellil''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to aid [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], Fellil was hunted by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Mahish]], but Fellil and a group of [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] hired by Organa ambushed Mahish in the mountains of [[Kaamos Territory]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] him. However, Imperial forces stormed the mercenaries' camp in the [[Fornaak Falls Cavern]], killing Fellil and the mercenaries.<ref name="Mission" />
